input: Prepare me for a meeting with Gong (gong.io)

what_they_do.value: Gong Revenue AI unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside revenue teams.

priorities.priority: Expand from revenue insights into autonomous workflow execution.
priorities.evidence: November release notes describe multi-step Custom Agents, ready-made agent templates, and MCP connections that let agents retrieve information and update records across tools including Salesforce, Jira, and Zendesk. Availability varies during the November rollout.

priorities.priority: Strengthen account and contact data through Gong Enrich.
priorities.evidence: Mission Callisto launched Gong Enrich to add third-party account and contact data to the Revenue Graph. Customers can sequence supported providers, reuse existing provider credits, and fill remaining gaps through Gong Credits. Enrich was generally available at announcement.

priorities.priority: Orchestrate coordinated work between sellers and AI agents.
priorities.evidence: Gong announced Activate, describing always-on agents that evaluate accounts, opportunities, and revenue plays, prescribe actions, and coordinate execution against a shared blueprint. The announcement presents this as the next evolution of its platform, not a confirmed general-availability release.

priorities.priority: Scale agentic engineering and enterprise security leadership.
priorities.evidence: Appointed Liron Shtraichman Chief R&D Officer to expand agentic capabilities and promoted Guy Havusha to CISO to lead security, privacy, and compliance as agents take on more revenue work.

priorities.priority: Drive customer adoption through measurable business outcomes.
priorities.evidence: Chief Customer Officer Simon Frey described successful Gong customers as starting with a concrete operational problem, reducing workflow friction, and proving impact rather than mandating AI adoption.

challenges.challenge: Enterprise AI trust concerns create an adoption barrier Gong is actively addressing.
challenges.evidence: Gong's research reported that 46% of planned AI investments were paused because of trust concerns. This is market-wide evidence, not a disclosed Gong sales-loss rate. The survey was conducted January 6–9, 2026, and published April 15, 2026; Gong explicitly describes embedding governance and explainability to address the barrier.

challenges.challenge: Core call recording and analytics face broad competitive convergence.
challenges.evidence: Sacra documents Gong-like recording and analytics capabilities across HubSpot, Pipedrive, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clari, Outreach, and other sales platforms. This supports competitive pressure on the original product category, but does not establish current Gong churn, discounting, or lost deals. The opened page did not provide a publication date.

recent_changes.headline: November updates extend Custom Agents and cross-tool actions.
recent_changes.summary: The help center documents multi-step agents, templates, and MCP-based retrieval and record updates. These features are rolling out throughout November; availability may vary.

recent_changes.headline: Gong names a Chief R&D Officer and promotes its CISO.
recent_changes.summary: Liron Shtraichman joins from monday.com; Guy Havusha moves from VP of Platform Security to CISO.

recent_changes.headline: Mission Callisto introduces enrichment and deeper AI investigation.
recent_changes.summary: Gong Enrich and Assistant Deep Mode were generally available at announcement. Expanded Dashboards and automatically triggered Custom Agents were described as rolling out during the year.

recent_changes.headline: Gong announces Activate at Celebrate.
recent_changes.summary: Activate is designed to turn institutional knowledge into coordinated actions by always-on agents and sellers, with outcomes feeding back into the Revenue Graph.

key_people.name: Amit Bendov
key_people.title: CEO and Co-Founder
key_people.recent: On November 4, 2026, said Gong's next phase is agents that take action and deliver results at enterprise scale.

key_people.name: Liron Shtraichman
key_people.title: Chief R&D Officer
key_people.recent: Appointed November 4, 2026, to lead R&D and expand Gong's agentic capabilities.

key_people.name: Guy Havusha
key_people.title: Chief Information Security Officer
key_people.recent: Promoted November 4, 2026; leads global security, privacy, and compliance for customer data and AI agents.

key_people.name: Eilon Reshef
key_people.title: Chief Product Officer and Co-Founder
key_people.recent: On September 30, 2026, explained that Enrich extends account and contact context back into the Revenue Graph.

key_people.name: Simon Frey
key_people.title: Chief Customer Officer
key_people.recent: On October 6, 2026, emphasized solving a defined business problem and proving outcomes before scaling AI adoption.

talking_points: With November's Custom Agents and MCP rollout, which workflows are the highest priority—and where is cross-system execution still difficult?
Following the CISO appointment, what governance evidence must customers see before allowing agents to take action?
As Enrich and Activate broaden the platform, which customer outcomes best demonstrate value beyond call recording?

cost_basis: tokens x list price + $10 per 1K web search calls
